top_signals.title: Bank of Canada Boosts Two-Week Repo Use to Ease Corra Strain
top_signals.summary: Bank of Canada Deputy Governor Toni Gravelle said the central bank is trying to reduce upward pressure on Corra by regularly increasing the size of its two-week repo operations.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
